_about: Coins (Shaked, 2026-10-22): earned by strong answers, spent in the shop and in duels. No monetary value, never bought, never cashed out. Every number here is a decision of Shaked's; change the file, not the code.

quiz._about: American questions from seeds/duel_quiz.json: five a duel, a minute each at most (Shaked, 2026-10-22)

pool._about: the judged mode only. What counts as a short question: the live bank has no question under three minutes by its own estimate and every live question is difficulty 5, so 'short' is a format a person answers in a few sentences. Grows as Harel's short questions reach the bank.
